summary: Provision 10 ephemeral Databricks interactive workspaces for MLOps benchmarking sprint — SSO/SCIM + invoice mapping
description:
Issue summary:
Request to procure and provision 10 ephemeral Databricks interactive workspaces for a two-week MLOps benchmarking sprint run by the Inference Platform team (ML Bench). Workspaces should be ephemeral (auto-terminate after 14 days) and accessible via Redwood SSO (Okta). SCIM provisioning must map to the existing ENG:MLOPS group and be scoped to 'interactive' role.

Impact:
- ML Bench sprint starting 2026-03-16 requires isolated workspaces to run large model throughput/latency tests.
- Delays will block benchmark timelines and push back model/serving optimizations.

Request details / acceptance criteria:
- Vendor: Databricks (managed workspace offering).
- Quantity: 10 ephemeral interactive workspaces (one per engineer).
- Access: Okta SSO app + SCIM group mapping to ENG:MLOPS.
- Billing: Single consolidated invoice; PO# PO-2026-MLBENCH to be attached. Charge to cost center ENG-ML-BENCH.
- Auto-terminate policy: 14 days after creation. Workspace creation must be scripted (Terraform) and PR provided.
- Entitlements: Interactive compute only; no long-term cluster provisioning.
- Security: Vendor must complete security questionnaire attached in Confluence page.

Procurement/financial details:
- Estimated cost: $8,400 total for 3 months of ephemeral access (estimate provided by vendor rep).
- Billing cadence: Monthly invoice to Redwood Finance, map to cost center ENG-ML-BENCH. Please ensure invoices list PO-2026-MLBENCH and show per-workspace line items.

Technical provisioning notes:
- Terraform module: infra/terraform/modules/databricks/ephemeral-workspace (PR exists: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2487).
- Required IAM groups: ENG:MLOPS (okta group id: 00g1abcDEF), map to Databricks Group 'ML Bench (interactive)'.
- SCIM needs read/write for group provisioning and user lifecycle.

Documentation and attachments:
- Confluence onboarding playbook: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/PROC/Databricks+Ephemeral+Workspaces+Playbook
- Vendor security questionnaire attached in Confluence above.

Next steps (owner: Procurement / Infrastructure):
1) Procurement to confirm pricing and issue PO PO-2026-MLBENCH.
2) Security review to confirm vendor questionnaire completeness.
3) Infra to merge Terraform PR and run provisioning in a restricted account.
4) Identity team to configure Okta app and SCIM connector; verify group mapping and test with 2 pilot users.

Acceptance criteria: 10 engineers can access their ephemeral workspaces via Okta by 2026-03-16; invoices include PO and map to ENG-ML-BENCH cost center.
